summaries.p-saltzer-schroeder-1975: A starting point for studying protection architectures and design principles.
summaries.p-terra-2003: Isolated VMs and remote software identification built around a trusted VMM.
summaries.p-haven-2014: Uses SGX to shield existing applications from an untrusted cloud platform.
summaries.p-sgx-explained-2016: A technical report analyzing SGX architecture and security assumptions; not a conference paper.
summaries.p-sanctum-2016: Combines minimal hardware extensions and a software monitor to address isolation and selected memory-access threats.
summaries.p-foreshadow-2018: A transient-execution attack study affecting secrets and attestation in the SGX implementations examined at publication.
summaries.p-graviton-2018: An architecture for trusted execution on GPUs, distinct from the AWS Graviton CPU family.
summaries.p-keystone-2020: An open framework for building customizable RISC-V trusted execution environments.
summaries.c-attestation: Evidence about a remote execution environment helps a verifier decide whether to entrust data to it.
summaries.c-enclave: Isolates selected application code and state from other software.
summaries.c-gpu-tee: Extends the trusted-execution problem to accelerator code, memory, and transfers.
summaries.c-transparency: Connects inspectable software artifacts to evidence about software actually deployed.
summaries.c-private-inference: A service-design category combining protected execution with attestation, key management, transparency, and routing. Implementations can have different threat models.
summaries.c-stateful-private-ai: Adds key, storage, and access-control lifecycles for state retained across requests.
summaries.c-nontargetability: A service requirement intended to reduce selective routing of a particular user to a compromised node.
summaries.t-intel-tdx: A VM-scale architecture designed to isolate Trust Domains from the VMM and other host software.
summaries.i-apple-pcc-2024: Request-oriented private inference using Apple silicon and a constrained runtime.
summaries.i-apple-pcc-gcp-2026: An announced PCC expansion using a Google Cloud configuration with TDX, NVIDIA GPUs, and Titan. Completed rollout requires separate evidence.
summaries.i-google-pac-2025: The 2025 introduction of a platform for private cloud processing with Gemini.
summaries.i-google-pac-memory-2026: A persistent-memory design update using device-held keys and encrypted storage; this does not establish general deployment.
summaries.i-meta-private-processing-2025: A design for WhatsApp AI processing using TEEs, RA-TLS, and transparency verification.
summaries.i-meta-private-processing-glasses-2026: A design extending Private Processing to stateful context and encrypted storage for AI glasses.
summaries.i-muse-secure-vm-2026: Per-user VMs, runtime isolation, and separated credential/permission services. Distinct from an operator-excluding confidential VM.
summaries.i-muse-confidential-vm-announced-2026: Announced and in limited testing in the September 8 source. Intended to cryptographically exclude Meta from VM data; general availability remains unverified.
summaries.p-flicker-2008: Isolates small code fragments and supports remote verification of their execution.
summaries.p-trustvisor-2010: A small hypervisor and software micro-TPM reduce the cost of isolated execution.
summaries.p-cloudvisor-2011: Places a small security monitor beneath the resource-managing VMM.
summaries.p-komodo-2017: Moves enclave management into a software monitor with machine-checkable proofs.
summaries.p-mi6-2019: Extends Sanctum-style isolation to a speculative out-of-order processor.
summaries.p-controlled-channel-2015: Shows how a malicious OS can extract information from memory-access patterns.
summaries.p-slalom-2019: Delegates selected DNN computation from a TEE to an untrusted GPU.
summaries.t-amd-sev: Per-VM memory encryption; distinguish its guarantees from later generations.
summaries.t-amd-seves: Adds protection of CPU register state to SEV memory protection.
summaries.t-amd-sevsnp: The 2020 whitepaper design builds on SEV and SEV-ES with integrity-oriented VM protections.
summaries.t-arm-cca: Separates resource management from access to protected Realm contents.
summaries.t-arm-trustzone: The isolation environment used by the Komodo prototype.
summaries.t-h100: GPU confidential-computing capabilities for extending protected execution beyond the CPU.
summaries.c-confidential-vm: A design category that places a VM-scale workload across a trust boundary from its host.
summaries.c-tcb: The design goal of reducing hardware and software on which a security property depends.
summaries.c-verified-monitor: An approach to checking correctness and security properties of a small privileged monitor.
summaries.std-rats: Defines the roles of Attester, Verifier, and Relying Party in remote attestation.
summaries.std-ohttp: Separates relay roles to reduce the connection between client identity and request contents.
